items.title: DreamPi self-updates are off
items.sub: /boot/noautoupdates.txt exists, so DreamPi neither updates its own scripts nor writes netlink_config.ini (DCNET stays off). Allowing it backs the file up and removes it; it takes effect when DreamPi restarts.

control.label: Allow
control.confirm: Back up and remove /boot/noautoupdates.txt? DreamPi then updates its scripts and writes netlink_config.ini the next time it starts.

items.title: Restore noautoupdates.txt
items.sub: It was backed up and removed here, so DreamPi updates itself the next time it starts (restart DreamPi or reboot). Put the file back and it stops updating itself again.

control.label: Restore
control.confirm: Put /boot/noautoupdates.txt back? DreamPi then stops updating itself and leaves netlink_config.ini alone.

control.label: Update now
control.confirm: Update the add-on now? It is fetched from GitHub and installed; this page is unavailable for a few seconds.
